pageSubtitle: The models {product} may call, the aliases skills and steps name, what each project may use, limits, and what it all costs. Providers are connections.
modelsHint: Each provider connection's models, found by asking it. A model is off until you turn it on; give it prices so limits can be in money.
noProviders: No model provider is connected yet. Add an Anthropic or OpenAI-compatible connection under Administration › Connections.
found: {name} offers {count, plural, one {# model} other {# models}}.
noModelsFind: No models yet. Find a connection's models to start.
structuredLong: Answers in a given JSON shape
noPrice: No price: its calls count as free
modelOn: On: aliases may name it and projects may be given it
name: Name
nameHint: What people see; its id unless you rename it.
perMillion: Per million tokens, in the site's currency.
aliasesHint: What skills and workflow steps name, such as fast or smart. Pointing an alias at another model changes every use at once.
aliasesProjectHint: This project's own aliases come first; the site's fill in the rest. Each names a model the project may use.
noUsable: No model is on and open here yet.
notOpenHere: not open to this project, so it doesn't answer here
accessHint: A project uses no model until you open some to it. You can also let its admins add connections of their own, and give it limits inside the site's.
accessDialogHint: What this project may use, and its limits. Its admins see these on the project's AI page.
openAll: Every model that's on, now and later
allowOwn: Its admins may add model connections of their own
projectLimitsHint: They apply inside the site's: a call has to fit both.
siteLimitsHint: They apply to every call, a project's included. A call reserves what it may spend before it runs, so calls at once can't go over together.
tryHint: A short call as you, through the same access and limits as any call. It's on the ledger.
projectSubtitle: The models this project may use, its aliases, its limits and what its calls cost.
projectAccessHint: A site admin opens models to the project and sets its limits.
ownAllowed: Its admins may add model connections of their own (Project settings › Connections).
ownNotAllowed: It may not use model connections of its own.
projectModelsHint: The site's models opened to this project.
projectModelsOwnHint: The site's models opened to this project, and its own connections' models, which you turn on and price here.
projectLimitsReadHint: Set by site admins. A call has to fit this project's limits and the site's.
allowOwnSkills: Its admins may use a skills repository of their own
exportsHint: A period's AI calls, to send to support when answers go wrong: one line each, with its prompt and reply where this site keeps them. You'll be asked for your password, it's in the security log, and each export is deleted after a week.
exportPrompts: {count, plural, =0 {no prompts} one {# with its prompt} other {# with their prompts}}
exportTruncated: Stopped at the most one export holds
exportDeleteHint: Its file goes now, before its week is up.
